rv.q: Thomas is equally powerful belting alto-fueled, blood-in-the-water blues and piercing the soprano stratosphere with the most delicate of operatic arias.
Thomas clearly has found her own star vehicle in 'Songs for Nobodies.' It's a knockout.
Each successive interlude is played out on a multi-level stage... 'Songs for Nobodies' is a multi-sensory experience.
Breathtaking, startling, stunning, astonishing — this writer can't think of enough synonyms to say Thomas amazes.
Finally she has the stage all to herself and she seizes the moment to score a stunning personal triumph.
This is an extraordinary evening of music and storytelling and Ms Thomas truly shines in every way.
